ops.title: Codex cc-notes review fixes and patch image validation
ops.body:
Outcome: implemented the three cc-notes review findings within authorized source scope; uncommitted. Public release, final frozen-source captain-hook/helper artifact, independent review settlement, and live rollout remain coordinator gates.

Scope and approvals
Started in /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/cc-notes/codex-ccn, preserving the prior uncommitted implementation. Coordinator then explicitly authorized captain-hook/file_operations.py and focused tests in galeocerdo, followed by cc-transcript patch parser/type/export files and focused tests in codex-transcript. No nested workers, commits, publication, global config/plugin-cache changes, or live app restarts. The expanded parser mutation/build completed beyond the usual 50-call delegate budget to leave a coherent tested source handoff.

Finding 1: dependency contract / release gate
plugin/capt-hook/hooks/__init__.py now diagnoses missing PostCompact, host-aware reads/changes, full patch images, and PatchEdit.apply_to before hook module import. scripts/test-hook-artifacts.py accepts explicit local wheel paths, prints SHA256, makes a temporary environment and home, builds cc-notes, provisions NLP resources, and runs inline plus both unit suites. CI performs the same capability check before provisioning/testing and selects one dependency version for both unit suites. Removed the independently stale PEP723 capt-hook==12.46.1 pin from test_cc_notes.py.
The existing CI CAPT_HOOK_VERSION=12.46.1 and plugin manifest >=12.0.0 remain explicitly unresolved release gates: neither represents a compatible published release, and none was invented. Exact CI capability invocation against 12.46.1 exits 1 with the new actionable ImportError (log /tmp/codex-ccn-old-contract.log). Raising the published plugin minimum and CI pin requires a real compatible release. README documents the minimum capability contract and local validation command.

Finding 2: host isolation
plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py:233#ktqr clears inherited CODEX_THREAD_ID for Claude calls and inherited CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID for Codex calls. CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID is untouched, including an explicit empty string. Codex still supplies its native thread ID and -R worktree. A real subprocess environment test covers unset, empty, and nonempty explicit overrides plus parent-environment preservation.
Before fix, three Claude override variants inherited parent-codex and failed; after fix all pass. Evidence /tmp/codex-ccn-fix-before.log and /tmp/codex-ccn-fix-after.log.

Finding 3: lossless patch images and comment guard
The prior cc-transcript parser dropped section selectors and rejected EOF markers. Existing public Hunk(old,new) remains unchanged; Rust PatchEdit privately retains selector, old/new line vectors, and EOF per hunk. Public PatchEdit.apply_to(pre_image) reconstructs native LF-default patch results without I/O, returning None for telemetry-only or unsatisfied edits. Matching searches the original image in native order, honors section and EOF positioning, tries exact then whitespace/Unicode matching, retains blank-line distinctions, applies replacements in reverse order, and supports pure insertions, deletion, and rename metadata. Parser rejects malformed chunk bodies. Telemetry keeps native_input unknown and chunks absent.
Critical sources: cc-transcript rust/crates/core/src/toolcall.rs:921#cn2v; rust/crates/core/src/toolcall/patch.rs:21#r4j7; rust/crates/py/src/views/toolcall.rs; generated cc_transcript/_native.pyi:1311#hx0y. pyproject.toml and uv.lock carry local version14.19.0+codex.5.
Captain-hook captain_hook/file_operations.py:79#ygzs reads the source, including rename source, at PreToolUse and consumes the Rust method. Existing old/new fields carry full images with content_scope=file when available; later events retain fragment semantics. No Python patch parser was added. Missing/unreadable update sources and unapplicable/telemetry-only operations do not fabricate an empty pre-image.
cc-notes plugin/capt-hook/hooks/comments.py:57#yj7f analyzes only full images. Tests reproduce separated three-comment hunks as independent blocks and a three-comment addition extending four unchanged neighbors as a seven-line block. A real code line separates the disjoint runs; blank whitespace alone is intentionally joined by the existing comment-block analyzer.
Native reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/rust-v0.155.0/codex-rs/apply-patch/src/file_update.rs and seek_sequence.rs. Thirteen fixtures compare reconstruction with the installed codex-cli0.155.1 --codex-run-as-apply-patch executor in temporary directories. These are default LF-update semantics; optional native preserve-line-ending mode was not implemented or asserted.

MCP and packaging evidence
The exact stage-probe cc-notes binary exited before handshake because /tmp/codex-port-stage-probe-1 was not a git repository. Same binary and isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME/DAEMONKIT_HOME initialize in a fresh temporary git repository: /tmp/codex-ccn-mcp-init.json. No broker or launcher failure was reproduced for cc-notes. Default generated package uses bare cc-notes, args mcp --host codex, omitted cwd, and explicit provenance override env_vars; /tmp/codex-ccn-fix-package-final validates that portable manifest. Native command probe /tmp/codex-port-native-command.txt independently confirms bare PATH command with omitted cwd preserves the thread working directory; I consumed that report, not reran its full app-server protocol.

Post-change validation
PASS ./scripts/test.sh -race -count=1 ./... in cc-notes: full suite, /tmp/codex-ccn-fix-race.log.
PASS go vet ./... in cc-notes: /tmp/codex-ccn-fix-vet.log.
PASS python scripts/test-hook-artifacts.py --capt-hook-wheel /tmp/codex-port-dist/capt_hook-12.51.0+codex.2-py3-none-any.whl --transcript-wheel /tmp/codex-port-dist/cc_transcript-14.19.0+codex.5-cp313-abi3-macosx_11_0_arm64.whl: 219 inline tests, all helper unit cases, 13 Codex suite methods; /tmp/codex-ccn-artifact-final.log.
PASS full cc-transcript .venv/bin/python -m pytest after parser changes:2840 tests; /tmp/codex-ccn-transcript-python-full.log. Initial local pytest used a stale source-tree native extension despite installed wheel; replacing that ignored extension with the exact rebuilt wheel fixed the environment, then full suite passed.
PASS cargo test -p cc-transcript-core:418 tests; /tmp/codex-ccn-transcript-core-full.log.
PASS cargo test -p cc-transcript-core --no-default-features:319 tests; /tmp/codex-ccn-transcript-core-minimal.log.
PASS cargo test -p cc_transcript_swift:4 tests; /tmp/codex-ccn-transcript-swift.log. Swift package tests and committed XCFramework rebuild were not rerun.
PASS targeted transcript Python tools/execution/patch/stub/export checks:249 tests, including13 actual native executor comparisons; /tmp/codex-ccn-transcript-python.log.
PARTIAL full captain-hook pytest:4639 passed,1 intentional skip,4 failed; /tmp/codex-ccn-hook-python-full.log. One failure was a stale native manifest expectation after a neighboring owner changed to bare capt-hook; I updated the owned assertion. Three subprocess tests launched uv in temp cwd without project dependencies. Retest with explicit source plus venv site-packages PYTHONPATH passed all45 focused host/patch/subprocess cases: /tmp/codex-ccn-hook-retests-final.log. No source fallback or test skip added. Full captain-hook make, Go, and helper suites were not rerun after this patch.
PASS separate installed-wheel CLI smoke without PYTHONPATH or VIRTUAL_ENV from temporary cwd/home, invoking /tmp/codex-ccn-fix-venv/bin/python -m captain_hook --host claude|codex --hooks TEMP/hooks run PreToolUse: both exit0 with installed wheel smoke context; /tmp/codex-ccn-wheel-cli-smoke.log. This rules out an actual wheel distribution import failure behind those three source-test environment failures.
PASS slop-cop check on plugin/capt-hook/hooks/README.md and plugin/skills/using-cc-notes/SKILL.md; advisory violations remain across existing prose (logs /tmp/codex-ccn-slop-readme.log and /tmp/codex-ccn-slop-skill.log); no blanket document rewrite.
PASS ccx vcs diff and git diff --check in all three touched repos. Added-comment audit found public API doc comments only.

Digest manifest /tmp/codex-ccn-final-artifacts.json. Transcript codex.4 remains an immutable intermediate built before stub regeneration; use codex.5. Captain-hook codex.2 includes the bare MCP command but predates the final neighboring packaging/skill freeze; coordinator reserved codex.3 for final whole-wheel/helper build. Existing helper codex.1 does not exact-match the new wheel. Signed matching helper, publication/CI pins, final independent review and live CLI/desktop/Orca rollout remain gates; no claims of those gates passing.
